title: Bernhard Fr-Udenthal - German Jew

CWC

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 1, Special Branch
REPORT

File No. __________
SHANGHAI S. B. REGISTER
No. S. B. D. ___
Date. February 27, 1940

Subject (in full) Bernhard FRUDINTHAL - German Jew.

Made by. D. S. Pitts        Forwarded by. D. I. Crawford

（批：Copy sent to D.）

Although enquiries have been made in circles
extensively frequented by the late Freddie KAUFFMANN,
no details are forthcoming that would assist in
giving information in connection with a German Jew
named Bernhard FRUDINTHAL who is alleged to have
been in Shanghai in 1937. Persons acquainted with
Mr. REISER never once met Dr. FRUDINTHAL while
investigations in local medical and refugee circles
have shown that he was not known here.

（印：FILE）

D. S.
A. C. (Special Branch).

上海特别处登记册
编号 S. B. D. ___
日期：1940年2月27日

事由（全称）Bernhard FRUDINTHAL - 德籍犹太人。

制作人：D. S. Pitts        转呈人：D. I. Crawford

（批注：副本已发送给 D.）

尽管在已故 Freddie KAUFFMANN 经常出入的圈子里进行了广泛查询，但并未获得任何有助于提供关于一名据称于1937年在上海的德籍犹太人 Bernhard FRUDINTHAL 的信息细节。认识 REISER 先生的人士从未见过 FRUDINTHAL 博士，而在本地医疗界和难民群体中的调查也显示，此处无人知晓此人。

（印章：归档）

D. S.
助理处长（特别处）。

page_data.en:
SECRET

I should be grateful for any information which
you may be able to obtain about a German-Jew, Dr.
BERNARD FREUDENTHAL, a dentist by profession, who was
in Shanghai for a short time in June, 1937. FREDDIE
KAUFFMANN of the Cathay Hotel before his death gave
FREUDENTHAL an introduction to his step-sister's
husband, a Czech named REISER, in Singapore where
FREUDENTHAL is now on parole.

"Y"

February 10th, 1940.

〔此处转录不清〕
page_data.zh:
机密

如蒙阁下获取有关德籍犹太人、职业为牙医的 BERNARD FREUDENTHAL 博士的任何信息，我将不胜感激。他于1937年6月曾短暂停留上海。汇中饭店的 Freddie KAUFFMANN 在去世前，将 FREUDENTHAL 介绍给了其继妹的丈夫，一位名叫 REISER 的捷克人；FREUDENTHAL 目前在新加坡处于假释状态。

"Y"

1940年2月10日。

〔此处转录不清〕

CWC
CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
S. 1, Special Branch Station, /
REPORT
Date February 29, 19 40.
Subject Edmund ROSNF LD.
Made by.. D.I.S. Killinbeck Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

With reference to the attached enquiry
regarding one Bro Edmend ROSNF LD, this man is
no doubt identical with Edmund ROSNF LD, who
is the proprietor of the "E R O." trading
company, with offices on the 4th floor of No. 131
Museum Road. The trade name E R O. is derived
from the initial letter of the Christian name
and the first two letters of the surname of
the proprietor.

ROSNF LD, who was born in Berlin on
April 11, 1900, is a German Jewish refugee, in
possession of German "J" passport No. II.2198/38,
issued in Berlin on August 30, 1939. He arrived
in Shanghai on October 9, 1938 on board the s.s.
"Conte Verde" and is now residing at No. 2, Yang
Terrace, Weihaiwei Road.

The firm E R O. has been established for
about one year and the chief business conducted
is the sale of boot-polish and a brand of
mouthwash, both of which products are manufactured
by a German Jewish refugee firm in Hongkew.
Although a sign on the door of the office in
Museum Road announces that "Import and Export"
business is conducted, most of the business of the
firm is done in Shanghai, with both foreign
and Chinese firms.

（印：INDEXED BY (S) REGISTRY DATE / / ）

Killinbeck
D. P. S.
A. C. (Special Branch).

S. 1，特别处分站 /
报告
日期：1940年2月29日。
事由：Edmund ROSNF LD。
制作人：D.I.S. Killinbeck 转呈人：D. I. Crawford

关于所附针对 Bro Edmend ROSNF LD 的查询，此人无疑与 Edmund ROSNF LD 为同一人，后者是“E R O.”贸易公司的业主，办公地点位于博物院路131号四楼。商号 E R O. 源自业主教名的首字母及姓氏的前两个字母。

ROSNF LD 于1900年4月11日出生于柏林，是一名德籍犹太难民，持有1939年8月30日在柏林签发的德国“J”类护照，号码为 II.2198/38。他于1938年10月9日乘坐“Conte Verde”号轮船抵达上海，现居住在威海卫路杨氏公寓2号。

E R O. 公司已成立约一年，主要经营业务是销售鞋油和一种漱口水，这两种产品均由虹口的一家德籍犹太难民公司生产。虽然博物院路办公室门上的招牌宣称经营“进出口”业务，但该公司的大部分业务是在上海与外商及华商之间进行的。

（印章：由 (S) 登记室编入索引 日期 / / ）

Killinbeck
D. P. S.
助理处长（特别处）。

British Consulate-General,
SHANGHAI,
27th February 1940
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 9115
Date 3 / 10）

Dear Mr. Yorke,

We would be interested to know the
nationality and occupation of Ero Edmend Rosefeld,
which name appears in the Shanghai Hong List Street
Directory as the occupant of 4th Floor, 131, Museum
Road. We have been trying to identify this name,
but so far without success, and thus any information
which you may be able to communicate to us will be
much appreciated.

Yours sincerely,
〔此处转录不清〕
Superintending Consul.

R. W. Yorke, Esquire,
Assistant Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
185, Foochow Road,
S H A N G H A I.

（批：PA / Early June. 29/3/40）
（批：NPS ... 〔此处转录不清〕）

上海，

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别处登记室
编号 S. B. D. 9115
日期 3 / 10）

尊敬的 Yorke 先生：

我方希望了解 Ero Edmend Rosefeld 的国籍和职业，该名字出现在《上海鸿名录街道指南》中，列为博物院路131号四楼的住户。我们一直试图确认此人的身份，但迄今未获成功，因此如蒙阁下提供任何信息，我们将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼，
